description: Operating model for Milestone 1.0M: First Autonomous Revenue Mission. Outlines the 17 stages of autonomous execution.

stages.purpose: Parse and validate the owner business goal. Confirm it is high-level and does not pre-define exact artifacts.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Validated owner goal object, confirmed no fixed artifact list is present
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if owner goal is empty or contains explicit hardcoded artifact list, halt and report

stages.purpose: CEO AI interprets the owner goal into a strategic mission framing. Defines desired business outcome, target customer, and success definition.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: CEO mission interpretation object: { strategic_framing, success_definition, department_activation_reason }
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — if CEO framing is vague, log and continue with partial framing

stages.purpose: COO distributes the CEO mission interpretation to all active departments. Each department receives the business context.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Department briefing log showing which departments received what context
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if fewer than minimum_departments_involved departments are active

stages.purpose: Each department independently proposes which artifacts it believes are needed based on the business goal. Departments must provide rationale for each proposal.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Per-department artifact proposal list with rationale, customer_value, and business_goal_mapping
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — if a department proposes zero artifacts, log why and continue

stages.purpose: Departments compare proposals, resolve overlaps, reject duplicates, and align on a final artifact list. COO facilitates.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Negotiation log with accepted/rejected proposals and conflict resolutions
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — if conflicts remain unresolved, COO uses tie-break rule

stages.purpose: Create the final artifact manifest from negotiated department proposals. Each entry must include owning_department, purpose, customer_value, business_goal_mapping, acceptance_criteria, and safety_review_status.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: artifact-manifest.json with at least minimum_self_selected_artifacts entries
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if manifest has fewer than minimum_self_selected_artifacts entries

stages.purpose: Each artifact in the manifest is assigned to a worker (AI department or sub-agent) for execution.
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — unassigned artifacts default to the owning department

stages.purpose: Workers generate each artifact according to the manifest. All artifacts must be written to artifacts/ai-company/mission-1.0m/generated/.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Generated artifact files under generated/ directory
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if an artifact fails generation after 2 retries, mark as FAILED in manifest

stages.purpose: QA AI reviews all generated artifacts against acceptance criteria. Scores completeness, customer value, commercial readiness, and safety.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: qa-review-report.md with scores and list of missing items or failures
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if safety score < 100 or completeness < minimum_quality_score

stages.purpose: Detect gaps in the product based on QA review output. Classify by severity, identify responsible department, and propose closure action.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: gap-analysis.json with detected_gaps, severity, closure_action, and status
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — if no gaps found, must explicitly confirm why

stages.purpose: Route critical gaps back to responsible departments for resolution. Repeat until all critical gaps are closed or max_gap_closure_iterations reached.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Updated artifacts and gap closure status records
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — if max iterations reached with unclosed gaps, mark as PARTIAL_PASS with explanation

stages.purpose: Assemble all approved artifacts into a coherent deliverable package. Create final-package-index.md.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: final-package-index.md summarizing what was built, why, and how owner should use it
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if fewer than minimum_self_selected_artifacts artifacts are included

stages.purpose: CFO AI and QA AI produce the KPI scorecard assessing mission success, department autonomy quality, customer value, and commercial readiness.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: kpi-scorecard.json with all required KPI fields scored 0-100
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if required KPI fields are missing

stages.purpose: CLO/Hermes extracts learning from the mission: what departments decided correctly, what was missed, and how autonomy can improve.
stages.failure_behavior: WARN — if memory write fails, log reason and continue

stages.purpose: Generate a Paperclip-compatible department mission update payload showing departments involved, selected artifacts, QA verdict, KPI summary, safety locks, and owner action needed.
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — if required fields are missing

stages.purpose: Run the department autonomy verifier against all produced outputs. Confirm all control outputs exist, policy checks pass, and safety locks hold.
stages.expected_decision_or_output: Verifier final verdict: PASS or FAIL with detail report
stages.failure_behavior: BLOCK — any FAIL verdict halts the pipeline

stages.purpose: Simulate merge readiness. Confirm all verifiers pass (1.0a through 1.0m), runtime reports are uncommitted, and no safety lock bypass exists.
